description_en: Disables an Auto Scaling policy for an application
description_zh: 调用DisableApplicationScalingRule接口禁用应用弹性伸缩策略
name: DisableApplicationScalingRule

parameters.help_en: The name of the Auto Scaling policy
parameters.name: scaling_rule_name

Code.description_en:
The HTTP status code.

2xx: The request was successful.

3xx: The request was redirected.

4xx: The request was invalid.

5xx: A server error occurred
Code.description_zh:
接口状态或POP错误码。取值说明如下：

2xx：成功。
3xx：重定向。
4xx：请求错误。
5xx：服务器错误

ErrorCode.description_en:
The error code.

This parameter is not returned if the request is successful.

This parameter is returned if the request fails. For more information, see the Error codes section in this topic
ErrorCode.description_zh:
错误码。取值说明如下：

请求成功：不返回ErrorCode字段。
请求失败：返回ErrorCode字段。具体信息，请参见本文的错误码列表

Message.description_en:
The returned message.

success is returned if the request is successful.

An error code is returned if the request fails
Message.description_zh:
附加信息。取值说明如下：

请求正常，返回success。
请求异常，返回具体异常错误码

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the Auto Scaling policy was disabled. Valid values:

true: The policy was disabled.

false: The policy failed to be disabled
Success.description_zh:
禁用应用弹性伸缩策略是否成功。取值说明如下：

true：禁用成功。
false：禁用失败

TraceId.description_en: The trace ID that is used to query the details of a request
TraceId.description_zh: 调用链ID，用于精确查询调用信息
